  lead pastor reads every meeting and who came). Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.39.5 - THE SUNDAY CHECK-IN OPENS BY ITSELF (with the 4 printed cards)
  - Check-in at church → Printed QR cards for Sundays → "Open the check-in by itself every Sunday, from 6:00 AM to 1:00 PM"
    (the hours can be changed). Each Sunday's check-in then opens by itself with that Sunday's printed card (card 1 on the
    1st Sunday … card 4 on the 4th, card 1 on a 5th Sunday). The cards already printed keep working; none are made again.
  - It is opened a few days ahead, at a sync (every sync looks at the coming Sunday), so this computer only has to sync once
    in the week before; it need not be on during the service. A Sunday opened or changed by hand keeps its hours, and a
    Sunday's check-in deleted by hand is not opened again.
  - The "Checked in so far" list is a little shorter on a small screen, so the window fits the church computer.
